chapters.text: Get AMS notifications on your phone or computer, even when AMS is closed.
On your phone, open AMS in Chrome (Android) — or on iPhone, first tap Share → Add to Home Screen and open AMS from the icon.
Open the bell (Notifications) and tap Turn on, then Allow.
From now on new leads, approvals, matches, kudos and reminders pop up like any other app notification. Tap one to open the page.
Turn it off any time from the same switch. Each phone or computer is turned on separately.
The Notifications page has a tab with an icon for each kind: All, Urgent, CRM, HR, Finance and System.

Profile → Notifications: choose your emails, mute a kind you don't want, and (Super Admins and managers who see all leads) tick Every new lead to get a notification with sound for each new lead from the API, website, Facebook or portals, saying who it went to.
For the sound, keep an AMS tab open, click once anywhere on the page after opening it, and keep Sound on (Profile → Notifications → Sound).
